judged_text: Placeholder string "refresh_token" can overwrite the user's real refresh token when the minimum schema strips it, causing irreversible data loss requiring re-auth

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING is enabled it validates against `minimumTokenResponseSchema` and then forcibly sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` if missing. Downstream code can persist this placeholder and overwrite the real refresh token. For example, in `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` the result is spread into `o365AuthCredentials` (`{ ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`) and then written back to Prisma, so an absent refresh_token in the response will replace the stored refresh token with the literal placeholder, leading to loss of the real refresh token and requiring re-auth.
